player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma i go long {num_rounds} raun.

Straksa Bilong Gem:
- Bipo yu mekim desisin, yu gat {total_conversation_rounds} tanis long toktok fri.
- Bihaen, tupela player wantaim bai mekim desisin long kooperet o defek.

Pei Ofa Matriks (i stap isi long kila raun):
- Tupela Kooperet ➜ kila {cooperate_reward}
- Tupela Defek ➜ kila {mutual_defect_reward}
- Wanpela Defek, wanpela Kooperet ➜ Defekta {defect_reward}, Koopereta {sucker_reward}

Hau Bilong Pley:
- Long toktok: typim eni tekst yu laik.
- Long desisin: kisim '[Cooperate]' o '[Defect]' (nogat kisim kasing). Yu ken addim ekstra tekst bipo/bihain token.

phases.conversation_finished: Konversesen i kamap pinis long raun {round}. Plez riposi wantaim '[Cooperate]' o '[Defect]' inside \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Man Namba 0 i wok gut wantaim, na man namba 1 i lusim.
